facts.business: Vishal Mega Mart operates as a retailer making aspirations affordable for middle-income India across fashion, general merchandise, food and grocery through its extensive network of stores and digital commerce.
facts.related_party_note: During the financial year ended March 31, 2026, there were no material significant related party transactions that may have potential conflict with the interests of the Company at large. Transactions with related parties as per Ind AS 24 are disclosed in Note No. 34 to the Standalone Financial Statements.
